company_info.description: Aqualine Ltd. provides emergency repair services for water supply products to individual and corporate clients in Japan. It offers a range of services, including unclogging blocks in toilets, kitchens, washrooms, bathroom leaks, and clogs; repairing leaks; selling plumbing products, and plumbing; and renovating water supply systems, as well as customer-oriented services, such as dedicated customer call centers and on-site customer visits. The company also provides mineral water under the aqua-aqua brand name; water dispenser services; and sales and installation of warm water cleaning toilet seats, washstands. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Hiroshima, Japan.
